Oneliner

Further develop the Exo-Brake system and demonstrate CubeSat Identity Tag (CUBIT) by DARPA.
Description

Further develop the Exo-Brake system, as well as demonstrate a CubeSat Identity Tag (CUBIT), a DARPA RF-ID system for future identification of functioning and non-functioning nanosatellites.

Results

Successfully demonstrated hydrogen inflation Exo Brake design and new TES avionics.
